title: Banque Delubac & Cie says intrusion led to customer data leak; fraud attempt failed
date_note: The bank's statement says the intrusion was detected on Friday 20 November.
geo_basis: headquarters region as Le Monde Informatique states it (an Ardèche bank founded in Le Cheylard); the victim's own site location not stated in the notice
summary: Banque Delubac & Cie says it detected an intrusion into its systems on Friday 20 November, with a failed attempt at fraudulent financial operations; it says no customer or bank assets are affected. The bank says the intrusion led to a leak of data on part of its clientele. It suspended online banking and fund movements; transfers were restored Monday morning. It informed the ACPR and CNIL and filed a complaint.
plain: French bank Delubac & Cie says hackers got into its systems on 20 November and tried to make fraudulent payments, which failed. Data on some customers leaked. It paused online banking and transfers; transfers are back.
exec: A French bank says an intrusion led to a leak of data on part of its customers and a failed fraud attempt; online banking and transfers were suspended.

validation.note: Primary source: the bank's own press statement on delubac.com (23 November), read; Le Monde Informatique (23 November) reports the same statement and adds that it gives neither the type of data nor the number of customers.
